title.label: Why is it not syncing with watch?

content.label: Recent update says issues with Apple Watch sync were addressed, but still both show different things

Absolutely awful tracking of times tasks ans synchronisation between phone and watch. The latest updated hasn’t done anything to fix this, if anything I can’t now see any task on my watch.
This makes this app useless except in the most trivial scenarios.

title.label: Great app but suddenly some of my streaks are vanishing

content.label:
I had some great time getting into my routine with this app as well as getting into more, but all of a sudden some/most of my streaks are disappearing from no warning, not sure why it’s even happening but I hope there’s gonna be a fix to this otherwise this app is no longer useful for me if my streaks are just disappearing.
Please fix.

Idea of app is great but unfortunately it’s buggy and often will lose weeks of data. I emailed customer service about this and they responded at first but then didn’t get back to me with a resolution, I want to love the app but the whole idea of the app is to keep track of things but I lose hope using the app when it has bugs that affect the entire reason I’m using the app in the first place.
Very flexible, only improvement I would like to see is by maybe being able to title the tabs to help group habits.
Disappointing you can only add 4 pages (i.e. up to 24 tasks). A fifth page (up to 30 tasks) would be a welcome addition. Disappointing.
Unintuitive, rubbish user interface and not fit for purpose- wish I’d gone with habit tracker instead
It’s helping me to form good habits. Love it!

Just started using this and love that I can customise the actions I want to do and timescales - so doing something 3 days a week still counts towards my goal, I don’t have to get a perfect every day. 

What I WOULD like is more fanfare when I meet my goals. Some kind of fireworks/confetti on the screen and maybe some music or sound effects. It just needs a bit more reward!

title.label: Great app used for ages but….

content.label: Have loved this app for a long time but the key part of its use was using it on Apple Watch to tick off streaks. Seems now from recent update that the complication for it on all faces won’t work anymore on my Apple Watch SE which is big disappointment. Not sure whether there is any scope to resolve this in future update?
Just what I needed to help keep a track of new habits. Simple and easy to get going with.

Pros: Simply but effective design, easy to use and minimalist. It has really helped with me keeping tracks of my habits and daily tasks Cons: failure to full complete tasks that require multiple completions in a day can’t as a fail, but looking back at history just shows a huge collection of failures when in reality days may be improving from 4/8 a day to 7/8 a day and it’s quite frustrating. Also, you can’t choose which pages are displayed on the widget and so I can’t do a 12 tile widget for my other pages on fail tasks, just a six but it’s massive. I really wish it was on the playstore!

Decent app with a fair amount of flexibility, but the algorithm that sends reminders needs a little bit of work. If you’ve completed four of six tasks (eg stretch calf) by 11am do you really need a reminder to complete the other two at 12 o’clock?  Surely the reminder should pop up at 4 or 5pm when it is starting to appear that the streak might be lost.

Simple app with questionable colour palette (you can customise the colours). Widget seems to be broken and doesn’t show any tasks. It didn’t work initially then worked for a bit and it’s broken again. I hope it’ll get fixed soon.

title.label: Paid for it but I’m uninstalling

content.label: It’s a good looking app with a very weird user experience.
You know when you think there should just be a super simple habit tracking/ticking app? This is it. And its nicely designed.

title.label: Timers are buggy, otherwise the app is awesome

content.label:
There seems to be a strange bug where the timer (for brushing teeth) is stuck at 0:00. It shows up on the Dynamic Island and Lockscreen forever. Deleting the task and rebooting my iPhone didn’t help

Not sure how this happened, but it’s annoying that the timer won’t go away. Would be 5 stars if this bug were fixed, it’s my only complaint in an otherwise perfect app!

title.label: Simple tracking for my daily habits

content.label: I’ve used the app for years now and seen it steadily improve. It still retains the simplicity of when I first discovered it and I appreciate that. The only thing I’d like you to include is the option for a ‘big fail’ option or a third option for tracking that expresses when you really slipped up… e.g. I’m trying to exercise everyday but I failed to leave the house. This could show up as a red mark on your record.

Great, but I am outgrowing this app now as there needs to be than 6 tasks in the ‘up next’ view as otherwise you can’t see them.  This is quite annoying as surely an extended up next screen whilst there are more then six is a simple fix. This can reduce to one screen once there are less then 6 for that day.

Finally an all
That makes everything easy set a apple shortcut for each habit it to make it even easier

Ive used this for a few days now and really has helped with day to day tasks, that a normal to-dos app just couldn't .

Really is quite powerful and can be used for many use cases, however i feel a couple of things have become niggles, first one being that once you’ve marked a task as complete theres no way to uncomplete it if done by mistake, second i feel like the main pages should be the categories (instead of being tucked away in a menu - ive found myself using the pages as daily, weekly, exercise, only to be limited by a list of 6 for each (following on from that, there shouldnt really be any limitation on the amount of tasks, 24 tasks might be a lot for one day but what about tasks all through the month/year), lastly ive put all my tasks into a daily category and then used that in the focus page… i feel it would make more sense to have a “home/today” page which filters out tasks for the day - im thinking this would be useful in many use cases.

One more thing that i think is more of a bug, if you set a monthly task, theres no option to define a specific date of the month as a reminder/notification

Great app though and will continue to use
No dots appear at the bottom of the page in order to change pages and I also can't swipe left or right between pages, so I only have a maximum of six streaks available
Such a good app for tracking habits.
Don’t like layout or the constant scrolling.

I absolutely love this app, if you are like me and like a to do list, ticking things off- this app will change your life! 
Before I brought it I read a review about how many tasks you can have on here and it wasn’t Many and it really put me off but I thought the guys review was great, and he made some really good points about “not taking on too much” so he understood why it was limited but they obviously listened and did increase it- I think they should again, people can only have a few if that’s what’s manageable for them! But I personally would love another page or two!! 😜

title.label: i love that its simple and free

content.label:
i have ADHD and i wanted a very simple and cheap habit tracker, and i love this one. I work in tech and i have some improvement suggestions: 

let us complete tasks in the widgets in iphones the same way we can in the app! that would be amazing. 

allow to add a task/habit without a specific goal or target. e.g. I take ADHD meds as needed so i don’t really have a goal, i just want to know how often i take them. (also, tracking habits without a goal, for people with mental health issues, just helps them know if they’ve generally been “feeling good” or “feeling bad” as sometimes we can’t tell) 

in the help section, when you mention a specific button, like “Up Next” or sth, adding a photo of the button somewhere helps “visual people” remember it better so they can find it easier and use it. 

what i love: the release notes, the help section, being able to change when the habits reset, the many icons and colour changes, being able to add a note to a task, and the task reports. 

brilliant app!! good job 👍
Streaks is brilliant. An amazing way to keep you on track towards your goals and the best thing is, it’s simplicity.

Confusing user interface to move tasks around. Constant sync conflicts will reset your streaks. Awful Shortcuts support that looks like it works, until one day it just breaks ruining your streaks. Avoid this app.

Confusing user interface to move tasks around. Constant sync conflicts will reset your streaks. Awful Shortcuts support that looks like it works, until one day it just breaks ruining you streaks. Avoid this app.
Great app. Very useful. I just wish you could add more tasks and choose when they are to begin. And more Health connections :D
I’m great at beating myself up for stuff I haven’t done or don’t do enough and Streaks is great at reminding me that the day/week/month hasn’t been the write off I sometimes think it has!
Would love to see some little celebration / gamification aspects e.g in Duolingo

I initially chose Streaks because I prefer to purchase an app outright rather than pay a subscription every month. The app interface is modern, clean and intuitive. It integrates with my other devices via iCloud and also has a watch complication.It has all of the complexities I need.
Excellent value, can share with family too, and could quite possibly change your life

This is the best habit tracking app but I’m not sure why it’s limited to 4 screens. I’ve seen older reviews mention this too and I can see the have upped the limit but why have a limited number of pages at all but I can’t really see the logic. Would be 5 stars if you could add more if I could actually add all the habits I want to track even it was a charge to add extras I’d pay it. On the look out for a replacement anyway.
Definitely recommend. It’s helped me so Koch already form simple habits. Such a simple yet effective app. But - setting it up is not totally intuitive that’s why it’s only 4*.

I downloaded and invested some time in this but ended up deleting the app after 20 minutes because:
1) if you long tap on a task it marks as complete - but you can’t undo this. I tried everything, nothing worked.
2) I couldn’t figure out how to link my health data (e.g. steps)
3) Once ‘in’ a task e.g. ‘go for a walk’, I couldn’t find my way back to the main task screen.
4) The colours are horrid

So, overall completely unintuitive for me, and no instructions/help. Waste of money and time. Might as well go back to using my excel spreadsheet :)
App is broken on ios 16. Does not open at all. Please fix developers

I have this app on my phone and iPad, whenever I open the app on either device, it ALWAYS overwrites what’s on the other device, it never sync first, so I end up with lost data whenever I open it on my other device :(

I used this app a while ago and it was quite good,  but it seems somebody let a monkey with a paintbrush come in to redesign the UI. It’s quite literally the least intuitive mess I’ve come across in quite a while. Colours are vile, the page transition effect is terrible and so jarring, god knows what that dropdown up top even does. Sometimes I can change pages and sometimes I can’t, and I can’t for the life of me figure out how to add more than one task per page…the plus icon disappears after adding the first task. The settings pop-out is horrible.

title.label: Great App but would love to have Full Report

content.label:
This is a great app and really helping me turn my life around in terms of some habits. But it’s also based on the mind set. 
This definitely helps and I love the reporting feature however I would love to have a report for all tasks on all pages in one report. 
Would love to see the devs doing that
Doesn't work properly on my mcair. Add new task button is not there, there is no way of adding more than 3 tasks. I want a refund.

I tried numerous others and found that none of them did what I needed. Too many unnecessary mewing about This is simple and easy to navigate. It does everything I need it to do and with tin a couple of minutes I was set up. Well done to the developers for creating this and for keeping the price so low.

Easy, and so so good in terms of breaking bad habits and making good ones. However, the challenge is to use the app constantly, and if you can do so and do what you said you were going to do, results might be great. Actually recording each cigarette or if you went to the gum today, thats the only problem. Don’t know if there is anything that can move a person, an app or something, who doesn’t really wanna move.

Perfect habit tracker. The interface feels slightly different to the norm, but always in a thoughtful and good way. For example, when completing a task, one clicks and holds, and a fill bar completes a circle around the habit icon and then pings in a satisfying way. Kind of addictive. If you start to build up many habits, there is a clear visual indication of what is complete and what is oustanding on the day. Plus everything you might want in calendar frequency and no of repetitions. Great tool, great UI.

This app massively reduces friction of habit tracking by automating most habits the iPhone and Apple Watch already track. The app works well and does not crash. Apple Watch faces are also good. Only addition I would like to see is the ability to track intermittent fasting, both in this app and with automated integration with the Zero app.
The last update lost me all my streaks and the latest back up was a month ago. A years worth of data gone.

title.label: Task badges still not saving properly

content.label: Despite recent updates task badges are still not saving properly from day to day. You can complete a task one day only to go in again the next day and find the streak has not updated and is showing as incomplete from the day before. I used to LOVE streaks and would recommend it to everyone but this is making it almost unusable.

title.label: Great but latest update is buggy

content.label: Not sure why but once you open up the app on mac and close it once, you can't bring back the window without quitting the app! A painful flaw in an otherwise excellently designed app.

After the latest updates it does not sync properly between the devices anymore like it used to.

Update 10.04.2022: the sync now seems to work better. Thanks.
